goal: Return an error when scanblocks cannot read block filters instead of silently returning incomplete results
Prevents callers from misinterpreting skipped unindexed blocks as having no matches
agreement: Concept approval for fixing silent block filter lookup failures (maflcko, fjahr)
Unaddressed objection: functional test relies on races and mines excessive blocks (fjahr)
Nonblocking objection: pre-scan index readiness check may be outdated on long scans (fjahr)
